name: connection.tier_drop
description: Voluntarily drop the connection's tier (no token required). Target must be lower than or equal to current.

tier.description: Target tier. Must be ≤ the connection's current tier; raising returns `ERR invalid_args`.

new_tier.description: Tier now active on the connection.

x-implementations.name: agent_native
x-implementations.description: Handled inline by the agent's lifecycle layer. Idempotent on equal-tier drops.

windows-modern.description: Agent-internal lifecycle verb; no Windows-specific behaviour. The downgrade is recorded synchronously before the OK is sent.

windows-classic.description: Agent-internal lifecycle verb; no Windows-specific behaviour. The downgrade is recorded synchronously before the OK is sent.
